title: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) Disaster Response Guidelines
organization: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Govt of India
authority: NDMA, Ministry of Home Affairs, Govt of India & National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)
statutory_shield: Disaster Management Act 2005 & Section 134A Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act 2019

protocols.protocol_name: NDMA & NDRF Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) Protocol
protocols.section: NDMA USAR Guidelines §5: Extrication Precautions & Crush Syndrome Management

steps.title: Establish Structural Scene Safety & Gas/Power Shutoff
steps.action_instruction: Assess for secondary structural collapses, falling debris, live broken electrical lines, and severed gas pipes before entering. Cut off main utilities if accessible safely from the perimeter.
steps.warning_note: Do not enter unstable rubble piles without NDRF/Fire Department shoring equipment.

steps.title: Protect Trapped Victims from Dust & Smoke Inhalation
steps.action_instruction: Cover victim's nose and mouth with a damp cloth or particulate mask to filter pulverized concrete dust and silica. Clear dust and debris from victim's face and airway.
steps.warning_note: Pulverized concrete causes acute toxic pneumonitis and airway obstruction.

steps.title: Crush Injury Syndrome Precaution (Prolonged Compression > 1 Hour)
steps.action_instruction: When a heavy beam, slab, or wall has compressed a limb for over 1 hour, releasing the weight suddenly floods the circulation with toxic potassium, myoglobin, and lactic acid (Reperfusion Shock & Cardiac Arrest). If ALS paramedics are arriving, coordinate IV saline hydration BEFORE lifting the slab. If ALS is delayed and limb was crushed > 2 hours, apply a tourniquet just above the crushed zone before lifting.
steps.warning_note: Sudden uncoordinated extrication of heavily crushed limbs can trigger fatal ventricular fibrillation within minutes.

steps.title: Cervical Spine Support & Thermal Insulation
steps.action_instruction: Immobilize head and neck while extricating victim onto a rigid backboard. Wrap with warm thermal blankets to prevent hypothermia.
steps.warning_note: Handle gently to prevent dislodging bone fragments or worsening internal trauma.

contraindications.warning_title: Do Not Release Prolonged Crush Without Preparation
contraindications.warning_message: Abrupt release of limbs compressed > 1-2 hours without medical readiness releases massive hyperkalemia and causes immediate cardiac arrest (Crush Syndrome).
contraindications.action_directive: Coordinate with 108 ALS paramedics for IV fluid loading prior to lifting heavy debris.

protocols.protocol_name: NDMA Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) & Gas Leak Protocol
protocols.section: NDMA Chemical Disaster Guidelines §4: Household LPG & Industrial Vapor Release

steps.title: Evacuate Upwind and Crosswind Immediately
steps.action_instruction: Move all persons immediately away from the leak in an upwind (against the wind direction) or crosswind direction. Dense gases (LPG, Chlorine) sink and pool in low-lying basements, pits, and drains.
steps.warning_note: Never walk into or downwind of a visible vapor cloud or odor plume.

steps.title: Strict No-Ignition / No-Electrical-Switch Rule
steps.action_instruction: Do NOT operate any light switches, electrical appliances, doorbells, elevators, flashlights, or mobile phones inside or near the gas area. Do not strike matches or lighters. A microscopic electrical spark can ignite an explosive fuel-air mixture.
steps.warning_note: Even unplugging an appliance or toggling a light switch creates an ignition spark.

steps.title: Protect Airway with Damp Cloth
steps.action_instruction: Breathe through a clean wet cloth, towel, or handkerchief placed firmly over nose and mouth. Water absorbs and traps water-soluble chemical vapors (such as ammonia and chlorine).
steps.warning_note: Do not take deep breaths while in the contaminated zone.

steps.title: Ventilate Area and Shut Valve from Outside
steps.action_instruction: If safe to do so without entering a dense gas cloud, turn off the main cylinder pressure regulator valve and open all external windows and doors. Call Fire Services (101) and Emergency (108/112).
steps.warning_note: If whistling, hissing, or high pressure roar is heard, evacuate area to at least 100 meters immediately.

contraindications.warning_title: Strictly No Electrical Switches or Open Flames
contraindications.warning_message: Operating electrical toggles, doorbells, or mobile phones inside an explosive gas atmosphere causes instantaneous vapor cloud explosions.
contraindications.action_directive: Do not touch switches; leave switches exactly in their current state and evacuate.

protocols.section: NDMA Flood Manual §3: Inundation Safety, Electrocution & Waterborne Hazards

steps.title: Avoid Walking or Driving Through Moving Floodwater
steps.action_instruction: Never drive or walk through flooded streets. Just 15 cm (6 inches) of fast-moving water can knock an adult down, and 30 cm (12 inches) can sweep away a car.
steps.warning_note: Submerged open manholes and washed-away road surfaces are invisible under murky water.

steps.title: Watch for Electrocution from Downed Power Lines
steps.action_instruction: Stay clear of submerged electrical poles, transformers, streetlights, and downed wires. Water conducts electricity over large distances.
steps.warning_note: If you feel tingling in water, stop immediately, turn around, and hop on one foot or shuffle feet together away from the source.

steps.title: Move to Upper Floors / Elevated Ground
steps.action_instruction: Evacuate vertically to upper floors of sturdy concrete buildings or designated NDRF flood shelters. Take emergency dry food, clean drinking water, flashlight, and medication.
steps.warning_note: Do not climb into closed attics where rising water can trap you; ensure roof access.

steps.title: Disinfect and Boil Water
steps.action_instruction: Do not drink floodwater or tap water from flooded mains without boiling for at least 1 minute or using chlorine purification tablets.
steps.warning_note: Floodwaters contain raw sewage, toxic runoff, and lethal waterborne pathogens (leptospirosis, cholera).

contraindications.warning_message: Flood runoff causes severe acute gastroenteritis, leptospirosis, cholera, and toxic poisoning.
contraindications.action_directive: Consume only sealed bottled or rigorously boiled water.
